{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode = Basketball |year = 2017–18 |team = Northern Illinois Huskies |image = Northern Illinois Huskies basketball wordmark.svg |image_size = 250 |conference = Mid-American Conference |division = West Division |short_conf = MAC |record = 13–19 |conf_record = 6–12 |head_coach = [[Mark Montgomery (basketball)|Mark Montgomery]] |hc_year = 7th |assoc_coach = Jon Borovich |asst_coach1 = Lamar Chapman |asst_coach2 = Brandon Watkins |asst_coach3 = |stadium = [[Convocation Center (Northern Illinois University)|Convocation Center]] |champion = |bowl = |bowl_result = }} {{2017–18 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball team''' represented [[Northern Illinois University]] during the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies, led by seventh-year head coach [[Mark Montgomery (basketball)|Mark Montgomery]],{{Cite news |last=Burton |first=Tom |title=Coach's seat gets warmer |url=http://northernstar.info/sports/coach-s-seat-gets-warmer/article_af42b84a-0482-11e7-99a6-77fd91ee80af.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170724031123/http://northernstar.info/sports/coach-s-seat-gets-warmer/article_af42b84a-0482-11e7-99a6-77fd91ee80af.html |archive-date=2017-07-24 |access-date=2017-08-16 |work=Northern Star Online |language=en}} played their home games at the [[Convocation Center (Northern Illinois University)|Convocation Center]] in [[DeKalb, Illinois]] as members of the West Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]] (MAC). They finished the season 13–19, 6–12 in MAC play, to finish in last place in the West Division. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Kent State Golden Flashes men's basketball team|Kent State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 15–17, 7–11 in MAC play, to finish in a tie for fourth place in the West Division. As the No. 9 seed in the [[2017 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]], they lost in the first round to [[2016–17 Eastern Michigan Eagles men's basketball team|Eastern Michigan]].{{Cite web |title=Northern Illinois vs. Eastern Michigan – Game Recap – March 6, 2017 – ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400945446 |access-date=2017-08-16 |website=ESPN.com}} == Offseason == === Coaching changes === Following the season, assistant coach Lou Dawkins left the school to take an assistant coach position at [[Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball|Cleveland State]].{{Cite news |last=Nicol |first=Scott A. |title=Men's basketball staff sees shake up |url=http://northernstar.info/sports/mens_basketball/men-s-basketball-staff-sees-shake-up/article_da3db4ca-200a-11e7-bcb6-ef859a329d8f.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170724002709/http://northernstar.info/sports/mens_basketball/men-s-basketball-staff-sees-shake-up/article_da3db4ca-200a-11e7-bcb6-ef859a329d8f.html |archive-date=2017-07-24 |access-date=2017-08-16 |work=Northern Star Online |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Cleveland State University |url=http://www.csuvikings.com/sports/m-baskbl/coaches/Dawkins_Lou?view=bio |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170817000648/http://www.csuvikings.com/sports/m-baskbl/coaches/Dawkins_Lou?view=bio |archive-date=2017-08-17 |access-date=2017-08-16 |website=Cleveland State University |language=en}} Assistant coach Jason Larson was not retained by the school following the season. On April 28, 2017, the school hired Lamar Chapman as an assistant coach.{{Cite web |date=April 28, 2017 |title=Lamar Chapman Joins NIU Men's Basketball Staff – Northern Illinois University |url=https://niuhuskies.com/news/2017/4/28/lamar-chapman-joins-niu-mens-basketball-staff.aspx |access-date=2018-01-09 |website=NIU Athletics |language=en}} On October 12, Brandon Watkins was hired as an assistant to round out the coaching staff.{{Cite news |last=Garcia |first=Eddie |title=Alumnus becomes assistant men's basketball coach |url=http://northernstar.info/sports/alumnus-becomes-assistant-men-s-basketball-coach/article_6293acc4-aef6-11e7-8896-67cac93871f5.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171015072414/http://northernstar.info/sports/alumnus-becomes-assistant-men-s-basketball-coach/article_6293acc4-aef6-11e7-8896-67cac93871f5.html |archive-date=2017-10-15 |access-date=2018-01-09 |work=Northern Star Online |language=en}} ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
